summary: The legal word length is capped at 20 characters, which is too small for an honest runtime-scaling verdict; the accepted implementation performs one bounded classification pass.

replacement_checks.evidence: After the constant-time length check, the accepted implementation inspects each character at most once and therefore performs no more than 20 classifications.

The certificate regression exhaustively checks 21,844 representative vowel/consonant/digit/invalid category strings of lengths 1 through 7, checks every permitted source character in boundary contexts, and checks maximum-length cases against an independent predicate oracle.
